About the space…

The Front Room is a premier live music venue in Croydon, programming diverse musical and theatrical performances in an intimate space.

Most of the events are programmed by the venue itself; always striving to find a balance between ‘top-class’ live quality and accessibility. The Front Room serves as a platform for improvised and experimental music & theatre, instrumental in launching the careers of up and coming artists and theatrical producers.
